أَنْبُوشٌ A thing that is taken, drawn, or pulled, out, or forth: (Lh:) the lower part of leguminous plants taken, drawn, or pulled, out, or forth: (S, K:) or trees pulled out by the trunk and roots: (K:) as also ↓ أُنْبُوشَةٌ : (TA:) or ↓ both signify what is torn out by the rain: (AHeyth:) pl. أَنَابِيشُ, (S, K,) the pl. of both the above words. (AHeyth.) ―
-b2- Also, Full-grown unripe dates that are pierced with thorns in order that they may ripen. (TA.) ―
-b3- And the pl. signifies Small arrows. (Sgh.) Some say that this pl. has no singular. (MF.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
